segment_captions.caption: Person A reaches for the silver container on the table while Person B gestures with their right hand.
C picks up a yellow packet from the table while A watches.
C picks up a yellow packet from the table and places it back down while talking to the seated woman.
C places a packet of snacks on the table while holding a cup in her other hand. Another person sits opposite, engaged in conversation.
Person A picks up a small packet from their lap and examines it closely while Person B continues to sit and talk.
Person A picks up a small object from her lap and examines it closely while Person B continues to hold a red object.
C pours water from a metal jug into a cup on the table while A watches.
C places a metal container on the table next to a plate of green fruits.
